title: Managed Database: external retention allocation — allocation duration
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database external retention allocation uses the following allocation duration basis. The allocation duration is the larger of the export retention duration and native included days.

## Duration case
Hypothetical inputs: an export duration of 5 days and included native duration of 7 days produce an allocation duration of 7 days. With a hypothetical export duration of 9 days and native duration of 7 days, the allocation duration is 9 days.
